info.title: course (Courses)
info.description: The Course API provides information about courses.

scopes.co-course.read: With this scope you can read all course resources.
scopes.co-course.write: With this scope you can write course resources.
scopes.co-course-category-admin.read: With this scope you can read internal course categories.

PersonClaimsResource.description:
A person with its claims. Claims can also be empty, if they were not selected or the client
has not the appropriate scope.

uid.description: Unique ID identifying exactly one person.

titlePrefix.description: Academic titles that go before the name of the person.

titleSuffix.description: Academic titles that come after the name of the person.

dateOfBirth.description: Date on which a person was born.

matriculationNumber.description: The matriculation number of a person, if the person is also a student.

emailStudent.description: The student email address of the person.

semesterHours.description: the planed semester hours for the lectureship

teachingUnits.description: the planed teaching units for the lectureship

lectureShipType.description: the code of the lectureship type

SelectableClaim.description:
## Enumeration of selectable claims that can be requested.

- **CO_CLAIM_ALL**: All claims of a person.
- **CO_CLAIM_TITLE**: The title of the person.
- **CO_CLAIM_DATE_OF_BIRTH**: The date of birth of the person.
- **CO_CLAIM_NAME**: The given name and surname of the person.
- **CO_CLAIM_EMAIL_STUDENT**: The student's email address. (puStPers.getEmail(*))
- **CO_CLAIM_MATRICULATION_NUMBER**: The matriculation number of the student.
